(CASE WHEN LOWER(rd.base_unit)=LOWER(cp.base_unit) THEN rd.qty_per_person WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='kg' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='g') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='l' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='ml') THEN rd.qty_per_person*1000 WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='g' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='kg') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='ml' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='l') THEN rd.qty_per_person/1000 ELSE NULL END) qty_per_person, CASE WHEN rd.review_flag=0 AND (CASE WHEN LOWER(rd.base_unit)=LOWER(cp.base_unit) THEN rd.qty_per_person WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='kg' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='g') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='l' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='ml') THEN rd.qty_per_person*1000 WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='g' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='kg') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='ml' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='l') THEN rd.qty_per_person/1000 ELSE NULL END)>0 AND cp.base_qty>0 AND cp.purchase_price>0 THEN (CASE WHEN LOWER(rd.base_unit)=LOWER(cp.base_unit) THEN rd.qty_per_person WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='kg' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='g') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='l' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='ml') THEN rd.qty_per_person*1000 WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='g' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='kg') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='ml' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='l') THEN rd.qty_per_person/1000 ELSE NULL END)*cp.purchase_price/cp.base_qty END cost_per_person, CASE WHEN cp.supplier_product_id IS NULL THEN '공급상품 연결 필요' WHEN rd.review_flag<>0 OR (CASE WHEN LOWER(rd.base_unit)=LOWER(cp.base_unit) THEN rd.qty_per_person WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='kg' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='g') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='l' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='ml') THEN rd.qty_per_person*1000 WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='g' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='kg') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='ml' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='l') THEN rd.qty_per_person/1000 ELSE NULL END) IS NULL THEN '단위 확인' WHEN cp.base_qty IS NULL OR cp.base_qty<=0 THEN '포장용량 확인' WHEN cp.purchase_price IS NULL OR cp.purchase_price<=0 THEN '가격 확인' WHEN (CASE WHEN LOWER(rd.base_unit)=LOWER(cp.base_unit) THEN rd.qty_per_person WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='kg' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='g') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='l' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='ml') THEN rd.qty_per_person*1000 WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='g' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='kg') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='ml' AND LOWER(cp.base_unit)='l') THEN rd.qty_per_person/1000 ELSE NULL END)<=0 THEN '사용량 확인' END missing_reason FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT ap.account_id,ap.mapped_ingredient_id ingredient_id,p.supplier_product_id,COALESCE(ap.link_base_unit,p.base_unit) base_unit,COALESCE(ap.link_base_qty,p.base_qty) base_qty, COALESCE(sp.purchase_price,mh.purchase_price) purchase_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ap.account_id,ap.mapped_ingredient_id ORDER BY ap.preferred_yn DESC,(mh.purchase_price>0) DESC,mh.effective_from DESC,mh.price_history_id DESC, (sp.purchase_price>0) DESC,ap.account_ingredient_product_id) choice_rank FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id AND p.active_yn='Y' LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history mh ON mh.price_history_id=( SELECT h.price_history_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history h WHERE h.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND h.effective_from<=NOW() AND (h.effective_to IS NULL OR h.effective_to>NOW()) ORDER BY h.effective_from DESC,h.price_history_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price sp ON sp.supplier_price_id=( SELECT h.supplier_price_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price h JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_offer_id=h.supplier_offer_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site a ON a.supplier_account_site_id=o.supplier_account_site_id WHERE a.account_id=ap.account_id AND a.active_yn='Y' AND o.active_yn='Y' AND o.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id AND h.effective_from<=NOW() AND (h.effective_to IS NULL OR h.effective_to>NOW())
